A brand new Minecraft release! In the meantime, a lot of under the hood fixes and a little rework on the config screen. There are also brand-new docs available for [users](https://github.com/legoraft/simple-armor-hud/blob/main/docs/user.md) and [developers](https://github.com/legoraft/simple-armor-hud/blob/main/docs/dev.md)!

### Features
- Moved buttons in config screen for better hierarchy
- Config file now uses same order as config screen
- Removed `Survival Tweaks` mention in config file
- Fixed some logging and added new docs

### Dependencies
- Requires [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- Requires fabric 26.2
